title: Coordinates in a tribe block
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $T$ be a subset of the $s w$ coordinates arranged as $s$ blocks of width $w$, and let $i$ be a block index. The frequency part of $T$ in block $i$ is the set of positions $o$ in that block for which the coordinate $(i,o)$ belongs to $T$.
